title: Tracking money you have asked for
description: The REQUESTED tab lists every request you have sent, what it is worth, and how many people have paid.
body:
REQUESTED is the list of everything you have asked for. Open a request to see where each person has got to.

Reading the list

  1. Open Payment. REQUESTED is the tab you land on.

  2. The columns tell you what each request is worth and how it is going.

  3. Open a request for its amounts and its due date.

  4. Below that, each person is listed with their own status.

  5. A request raised on a team also appears on that team's PAYMENT tab.

What the columns mean

  • Per Person is the base price - what one player owes.
  • Total is that multiplied by the number of people on the request.
  • Paid and Unpaid count people, not money. "0 / 2" means neither of the two has paid yet.
  • Status is the request as a whole. See "Payment statuses and failed payments".

Both money columns show the base price. The transaction fee is not in this table. To see what a player is actually charged, look at their side of it in "Paying a request you have received".

Where a request appears

Where you raised a request decides where it shows up. One raised against a team appears on that team's PAYMENT tab; one raised against a match appears on the match. Every request you have sent appears under REQUESTED, wherever it came from.
